posts.caption:
Branded, not labeled.
No logo printed on the leather. The DAUR mark lives on the hardware: a brass lace tag on the bottom row and the DAUR SUPPLY UNIT seal on the top eyelet. Keep the seal on until you are sure of the size; it is needed for a size exchange.
#DAURSupply #BrandedNotLabeled #LeatherShoes #MensStyle
